name: Mango Kush Infused Pre-Roll | 1g
description: Mango Kush is an indica dominant hybrid strain and an absolute classic. This strain’s aroma and flavor is of sweet, rich mango with a touch of creamy peach and honey, layered on a base of floral and sweet gas. Mango Kush will help you relax, but before putting a big smile on your face and giving you a case of the giggles. Its dominant terpenes are Ocimene and Myrcene.
